description: This file defines UI components and formatting logic for displaying node information within a macOS application built with SwiftUI. It includes functions for formatting node entries, determining icons, and rendering list items representing network nodes or gateway devices.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: Provides static methods for formatting node information, determining icons, and generating display strings based on node attributes.

classes.name: NodeMenuRowView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single row in a node menu, displaying node icon, name, status, and other details.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A SwiftUI view rendering a custom icon indicating Android devices.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Checks if the node entry is a gateway.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the node entry is currently connected.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns the primary display name for the node, defaulting to 'Gateway' or nodeId when displayName is empty.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string for the node, including host IP, platform, versions, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the node's connection role/status.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides a simple string combining IP and role.

methods.name: headlineRight
methods.description: Returns optional platform text for display.

methods.name: detailRightVersion
methods.description: Returns version labels for the node, formatted for display.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Determines a human-readable platform string based on node's platform or device family.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Formats version labels, adding a 'v' prefix if needed.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Retrieves core and UI version labels for the node, with compact or full formatting.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Resolves core and UI versions, falling back to legacy version if needed.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Determines if the platform is considered headless based on platform string.

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Selects a suitable SF Symbol name based on device type or role.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Detects if the node represents an Android device.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Checks if a system symbol exists, returning fallback if not.
